copy.heading: Bath time
body: Bath time in your house runs from 6.30pm to 7pm. It involves two small children, one bath, a quantity of water no longer in the bath and a floor that needs mopping. It is one of the most demanding half-hours in the household, and the engagement's records show that you have attended eleven of the last sixty.
The other forty-nine clashed with padel. Some were a "quick hit". Some were a "social". Two were a padel league match that you described in advance as "a big one", and which you lost.

Lauren would like bath time to be shared. The engagement proposes three nights a week, starting now. Please note that you should arrive before bath time begins, not during the story, and certainly not after the children are asleep, holding a protein shake.
